method.ratio: O2/O1 hot wall time; lower is faster
method.compile_time: Median process wall time, including JVM startup and output I/O

joint_validation.note: The benchmark status covers these fixed workloads only; it is not full JIT acceptance.

repeat_note: All initially over-5% cases were independently repeated with twice the target batch duration. Original observations and outliers are retained. Byte-identical controls are not evidence of compiler speedup.
